title: Total RNA Preparation from Plasmodium falciparum for Transcriptome Analysis
author: Unknown
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.i33cgqn

steps.title: Isolate Plasmodium falciparum from infected RBCs
steps.instruction: Isolate free parasites from packed PfRBCs using ultrapure water and centrifugation.

substeps.instruction: Add 12 ml of ultrapure water (Wako Pure Chemical Industries, catalogue no. 210-01303) at 4 °C to 0.8 ml of packed PfRBCs.
Keep on ice for 10 min to lyse PfRBCs.
Centrifuge for 10 min at 1750g at 4 °C.
Transfer the sediment to a new 1.5 ml micro tube.
Centrifuge for 5 min at 3500g at 4 °C.
Completely aspirate the supernatant.

steps.title: Protect parasite nucleic acids
steps.instruction: Stabilize the isolated parasites using RNAprotect Cell Reagent.

substeps.instruction: Add 100 µl RNAprotect Cell Reagent (Qiagen GmbH, Hilden, Germany) to the sediment.
Suspend completely by vortexing.
Store the mixture at -20 °C or -80 °C.

steps.title: Harvest total RNA using RNase plus Mini kit
steps.instruction: Extract total RNA from the parasites using the RNase plus Mini kit (Qiagen, catalogue no. 74134).

substeps.instruction: Pellet less than 1x 10^7 parasites by centrifugation for 5 min at 3500g and remove the supernatant.
Add 600 µl Buffer RLT Plus enriched with 1% ß-mercaptethanol and vortex to create a lysate.
Homogenize the lysate using a QIAshreddar spin column (Qiagen) in a 2 ml collection tube; centrifuge for 2 min at maximum speed (14000g).
Transfer homogenized lysate to a gDNA Eliminator spin column in a 2 ml collection tube; centrifuge for 30 s at 8000g and save the flow-through.
Add 600 µl (equal volume) of 70% ethanol to the flow-through and mix well.
Transfer the sample to a RNeasy spin column in a 2 ml collection tube; centrifuge for 15 s at 8000g and discard the flow-through.
Add 700 µl Buffer RW1 to the RNeasy spin column; centrifuge for 15 s at 8000g and discard the flow-through.
Add 500 µl Buffer RPE to the RNeasy spin column; centrifuge for 15 s at 8000g and discard the flow-through.
Add another 500 µl Buffer RPE to the RNeasy spin column; centrifuge for 15 s at 8000g and discard the flow-through.
Place the RNeasy spin column in a new 2 ml collection tube and centrifuge at full speed (14000g) for 1 min.
Place the RNeasy spin column in a new 1.5 ml collection tube.
Add 30 µl RNase-free water directly to the spin column membrane and centrifuge for 1 min at 8000g to elute the RNA.

steps.title: Confirm RNA concentration and purity
steps.instruction: Assess the quality and quantity of the harvested RNA.

substeps.instruction: Estimate the RNA concentration using a NanoDrop ND-100 (Thermo Fisher Scientific Inc., Tokyo, Japan).
Confirm the purity using an Agilent 2100 Bioanalyzer (Agilent Technologies Japan, Ltd., Tokyo, Japan), ensuring the electrophoregram shows clear peaks for 18s rRNA and 28s rRNA.
